# PJR-AG0C guarded-push の dry-run が、新しいブランチの commit の件数に全部の履歴を数える

## 1. 課題
… output omitted …
告にした。古い tracking ref や fetch URL と push URL の違いで件数がずれないようにするため。既存の fast-forward 確認と同じ方針である。
- 基準の commit が手元にないときは fetch して正確に数える。fetch しないと、remote 側で進んだブランチの祖先も「remote にない」と数えて件数が膨らむため。fetch するのは手元にない先端だけに絞った。
- `Range` に全ブランチの名前を並べると長くなるため、名前順の先頭 5 件と残りの件数（`+N more`）に絞った。

final_message: Changed guarded-push so that, for a branch the remote does not have yet, Commits counts only commits missing from every branch the push endpoint advertises, and Range names the base remote branches (first 5 by name, then +N more). The display for branches already on the remote is unchanged. Added one integration test and ran only the guarded-push integration test file: all 9 tests passed. Updated the ticket's impact table and response section, including the CHANGELOG draft.
handoff: Decision: the base for a new branch is the branch list taken directly from the push endpoint (`ls-remote --heads`), not local `refs/remotes/<remote>/*`. This keeps the count from being thrown off by stale tracking refs or a push URL that differs from the fetch URL, the same approach as the existing fast-forward check.

Decision: when a base tip commit is missing locally, it is fetched as objects only, even during `--dry-run`, without writing refs or `FETCH_HEAD`. Without this, ancestors of remote branches that moved ahead would also be counted as missing from the remote. Only missing tips are fetched.
Decision: listing every branch name in Range would make it long, so it shows the first 5 by name plus `+N more`.

CHANGELOG draft (category Fixed): when `guarded-push` shows a branch the remote does not have yet, `Commits` now counts only commits missing from every remote branch instead of the full history, and `Range` shows the remote branches used as the base. `CHANGELOG.md` was not changed.

Open in the ticket's work table: after integration, the orchestrator runs `--dry-run` on a feature branch the remote does not have and checks that the count and range are clear, then closes the ticket.
